summary: check_plan and check_boot_copy of tools/dev/machine_grow.sh, through tests/system/machine_grow_check.sh on real seed file systems and a whole boot partition, with each check taken out of a private copy of the script

faults.name: ranges
faults.summary: a check_plan that does not compare the ranges with the geometry

edits.find: cmp "$work/ranges.txt" "$work/expected-ranges.txt" || fail 'ranges differ from the seed and target geometry'

lines: machine-grow-check: failed: small omitted range accepted

faults.name: boot
faults.summary: a check_boot_copy that does not compare the boot copy with the disk

edits.find: [ "$actual_boot" = "$expected_boot" ] || fail 'the boot backup differs from the disk'

lines: machine-grow-check: failed: same-length boot corruption accepted
